name: rooms-protocol
title: rooms_sdk wire protocol
description: Frame-level wire contract of the rooms_sdk room engine (RoomHub). Derived from the implementation, not the prose: every hub-handled frame below is cross-checked against the source at build time (site/scripts/check-spec.mjs).

protocolVersion.rule: chosen by the game; the client's join.protocol must exactly equal the hub's configured value or the join is rejected ('Incompatible game version')

transport.framing: JSON text frames (UTF-8). Client-to-server frames MUST be text (binary frames are rejected as 'Message too large') and are capped at 4096 characters. Server-to-client state frames (snapshots and deltas) MAY be binary when the client opts in with binaryStates and the room has a WireStateCodec; binary frames never begin with '{' so both kinds share one transport, and JSON remains the fallback.

lanes.control: reliable, ordered (GameConnection.send / sendBytes). Handshake, social, error frames, baselines and recovery snapshots always use it.
lanes.state: optional disposable lane when the transport implements StateGameConnection.sendState / BinaryStateGameConnection.sendStateBytes. JSON deltas (frames starting with {"type":"state",) and binary deltas prefer it; loss of a state frame never stalls the receiver because the next baseline repairs it.
lanes.binary: when the peer requested binaryStates, the transport implements BinaryGameConnection and a WireStateCodec is configured, snapshots and deltas are encoded through the codec. Binary frames never begin with '{', so binary and JSON frames can share a transport during migration.

inputRate.scope: per peer, wall-clock second windows; exceeded frames throw 'Input rate exceeded' (error frame + close 1008)

stallBuffer.credit: after a host stall >= 250 ms each peer gets stallMs * 120/1000 extra packets (capped), so a blocked host does not disconnect honest clients

receiverStall.eviction: no ack progress for > 5 s while blocked -> close 1001 'State receiver stalled'
receiverStall.recovery: while blocked, at most one recovery snapshot per simulationHz ticks

snapshot.quantization: floats rounded to 4 decimal places (float32 deadband: sub-quantum changes drop out of deltas)
snapshot.baselineRefreshTicks: simulationHz (about once per second) and on any epoch change; deltas always refer to the current reliable baseline, never to another delta

handshake.resumeGraceNote: resumeGrace is a RoomHub constructor parameter; 15 s is the default

limits.playerName: 1-24 characters after trim; control characters and bidi overrides rejected

chat.text: single line, trimmed, no control characters or bidi overrides

moderation.banRequires: an identity verified by the transport adapter, never a join payload

room.capacity: >= 1, declared by the authority; joins beyond it are refused with 'Room is full'
room.clock: fixed step 1/simulationHz; wall-clock catch-up clamped to 0.1 s per advance, so simulated time never dilates under load

frames.name: join
frames.when: first frame on a fresh transport; must arrive within the 5 s join timeout or the transport is closed (1008 'Join timeout')

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "join"; anything else is 'Incompatible game version'

fields.name: protocol
fields.note: must exactly equal the hub's protocolVersion

fields.name: name
fields.required: fresh join (ignored when resume is present)
fields.note: 1-24 chars after trim, no control/bidi characters; the hub trims before storing

fields.name: resume
fields.note: one-time resume token from a prior welcome. Unknown token -> 'Session expired; join again'. Bound to the transport-verified identity: a different identity gets 'Session identity changed; join again'. On success the old transport is closed (1000 'Reconnected elsewhere')

fields.name: binaryStates
fields.note: true opts the peer into the binary state lane when transport + codec support it

frames.extra: the whole decoded message (including game-specific fields) is passed to RoomAuthority.validateJoin; it may reject the join or return join data for addPlayer/resume
freshJoinRefusals: banned transport identity -> 'You are banned from this room'
locked room -> 'The host has locked this room'
frames.onError: error frame with the reason, then close 1008

frames.name: ack
frames.when: any time after welcome; a bare ack is consumed by the hub and never reaches the authority

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "ack"

fields.name: ack
fields.note: latest applied snapshot tick. Accepted on ANY client frame (not just type=ack) when ackTick <= ack <= sentTick; advances the peer's ack clock and lastAckAt, which drives stall eviction

frames.name: chat
frames.when: after join; rides the social lane

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "chat"

fields.name: text
fields.note: 1-280 chars, single line, trimmed, no control/bidi characters; rate 4 / 10 s

frames.onError: socialNotice to the sender only (no disconnect): 'Use 1-280 characters on one line', 'Chat is too fast; wait a few seconds'

frames.name: ping
frames.when: after join; requires the authority to implement RoomSocialAuthority (coordinates are authority-supplied, never client-supplied)

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "ping"

fields.name: kind
fields.note: one of here | help | ball; rate 3 / 5 s

frames.onError: socialNotice: 'Ping unavailable' (bad kind, authority without locations, or no coordinates), 'Pings are too fast; wait a few seconds', 'Unknown ping'

frames.name: moderate
frames.when: leader only (RoomSocialAuthority.roomLeaderId if implemented, else the first connected peer); non-leaders get 'Only the host can manage the room'

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "moderate"

fields.name: action
fields.note: lock | kick | ban

fields.name: locked
fields.note: new lock state; locked rooms refuse fresh joins

fields.name: playerId
fields.note: must be another present peer ('Choose another player'); the target receives a removed frame and is closed with 1008. ban additionally records the target's verified transport identity (list capped at 256); unauthenticated targets cannot be banned

frames.name: leave
frames.when: voluntary leave; releases the slot immediately (no resume)

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "leave"

frames.effects: removePlayer, roster broadcast, system chat 'left the room'; the leaver is sent a left frame and the transport closes normally

frames.name: command (game-defined)
frames.when: every non-handshake frame whose type is not join/ack/chat/ping/moderate/leave is delivered verbatim to RoomAuthority.command(peerId, message) after rate limiting and piggybacked ack processing

fields.name: type
fields.note: game-defined; the hub attaches no meaning

fields.name: ack
fields.note: piggyback ack, processed by the hub before dispatch
game payload, capped by the 4 KB frame limit and the 120/s input rate

documentedInstances.where: relay template: writes the sender's own player row key (quota-enforced, drop-and-count on rejection)
relay template: writes a leader-only room row
physics template: declared-axis movement intent, clamped server-side, rate inputsPerSecond

frames.onError: an exception thrown from command is a protocol error (error frame + close 1008); tolerant authorities drop-and-count instead (see docs/room_templates.md)

frames.name: welcome
frames.when: immediately after a successful join or resume handshake

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "welcome" (hub-forced, overrides any authority key)

fields.name: protocol
fields.note: the hub's protocolVersion (echo)

fields.name: id
fields.note: hub-assigned peer id (p1, p2, ...); stable across resume

fields.name: resume
fields.note: one-time resume token; reuse after the grace window is refused

fields.name: capacity
fields.note: authority.capacity echo
spread from RoomAuthority.welcome(id) — game fields (relay: {"sequence":0}; physics adds the assigned spawn)

frames.name: baseline
frames.when: right after welcome on every join/resume: the full quantized snapshot with its type field rewritten from "snapshot" to "baseline"

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "baseline"

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: authority epoch; an epoch change forces a new baseline everywhere

fields.name: tick
fields.note: baseline tick; deltas reference it as state.base
full authority snapshot state (game-defined; floats quantized to 4 decimals)

frames.name: snapshot
frames.when: (a) immediately after the join/resume baseline, with initial: true; (b) periodic baseline refresh (every simulationHz ticks, or on epoch change) without initial; (c) recovery: while a receiver is stalled, at most once per simulationHz ticks, with initial: true — a display-only frame that never becomes the delta baseline

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "snapshot" (the authority supplies it; the hub preserves it)

fields.name: initial
fields.note: true on the join-time frame and on recovery frames; clients seed their playback clock from it
full authority snapshot state

frames.name: state
frames.lane: state (disposable when the transport provides one, else control)
frames.when: snapshot cuts whose quantized snapshot differs from the current baseline

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "state"

fields.name: base
fields.note: tick of the baseline this delta refers to; a receiver holding a different base (or epoch) discards the delta and waits for the next baseline — a lost or reordered delta cannot corrupt the next one

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: must equal the receiver's baseline epoch

fields.name: delta
fields.note: { remove?: string[], set: { [key]: value | { patch: <recursive delta> } } } — nested maps diff recursively as patch; presence masks preserve resets to zero/false/null

frames.name: social
frames.when: after every roster change (join, resume, leave, kick/ban, lock) and once with history right after the join/resume snapshot

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "social"

fields.name: leaderId
fields.note: authority-declared leader or first-connected-peer fallback

fields.name: members
fields.note: [{ id, name, connected (bool, false while inside the resume grace window), canBan (bool, true only with a verified identity), profile (optional host-supplied identity profile map, e.g. {did, handle, displayName, avatar} for AT Protocol sign-ins) }]

fields.name: history
fields.note: chat history (most recent, capped at 100) — present only on the join/resume roster

frames.name: chat
frames.when: broadcast to every connected peer on chat, and as system notices on join ('joined the room'/'reconnected'), leave ('left the room') and kick/ban ('was removed by the host')

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "chat"

fields.name: message
fields.note: { id (int, monotonic), playerId, playerName, text, system (bool) }

frames.name: ping
frames.when: broadcast when a peer's ping passes validation; expires after 8 s

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "ping"

fields.name: ping
fields.note: { id (int), playerId, playerName, kind (here|help|ball), location: { x, y, z (finite doubles), epoch (int) } } — coordinates are authority-supplied

frames.name: left
frames.when: sent to the peer that sent leave, just before its transport closes

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "left"

frames.name: removed
frames.when: sent to the target of a kick or ban before the transport is closed with 1008

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "removed"

fields.name: message
fields.note: 'The host removed you from this room' or 'The host banned you from this room'

frames.name: socialNotice
frames.when: a rejected chat/ping/moderation attempt; sent to the offending sender only, no disconnect

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "socialNotice"

fields.name: message
fields.note: human-readable reason

frames.name: error
frames.when: any protocol error: non-text or oversized frame, invalid JSON, wrong join type/protocol, bad name, banned identity, full room, expired/identity-changed resume, locked room, validateJoin/command exceptions, input rate exceeded. Always followed by close 1008 'Invalid request'

fields.name: type
fields.note: literal "error"

fields.name: message
fields.note: FormatException/StateError message, or 'Malformed message' for anything else

closeCodes.when: the same session resumed from a new transport; the old transport is closed
hub.close() — also the drain path (node DELETE /v1/rooms/:id)
receiver blocked (sentTick - ackTick >= simulationHz/2) with no ack progress for > 5 s
no join frame within 5 s of transport attach
any protocol error after an error frame
